items.Sentence: In the headworks, wastewater is filtered through dual bar screens with 3-millimeter openings
The filtered wastewater is collected in a 50,000 gallon underground fiberglass equalization tank with aeration to provide mixing
From the equalization tank, the wastewater is then pumped into the anoxic basin
The anoxic basin is sized for denitrification and has a mixer to maintain the solids in solution while not providing any air to the waste

The flow is moved to the aerated membrane bioreactor (MBR)... The current WWTF provides tertiary treatment that combines an activated sludge process, membranes to filter the wastewater, and ultraviolet (UV) disinfection
Within this system is the UV treatment process which acts as a disinfectant and is the last treatment step prior to dispersal
Sludge separated from the effluent in the treatment process is dewatered using a centrifuge
an existing centrifuge is utilized, as well as an off-board waste activated sludge (WAS) storage
Order 99-086 allowed a discharge of up to 0.08 million gallons per day (mgd) of secondary disinfected domestic effluent
In the winter, effluent is discharged to three leachfields... In the summer... a subsurface drip disposal system is available for use
The use of landscape irrigation for wastewater disposal shall not occur until the Title 22 Report has been approved
dual usage of the subsurface drip system along with a 150,000 gallon storage tank and the expanded leachfield should provide sufficient disposal capacity
